title: Future Magic Golem
text: “Ugh…”
Big Sister’s older sister and the Panda’s belly keep shaking.
“Rasa, since you’ve been entrusted with the great responsibility of bearing the Hero’s child, you must risk your very life to take on this challenge.”
“Elmelo… you guys better remember this.”

The Panda is hurling curses at her Father and the Elephant. Should I help the Elephant here? But I have a feeling that even if I don’t, it won’t end badly for him… After all, my Big Sister’s Big Sister was looking for a shrinking potion, wasn’t she?
“In Naofumi’s case, since he’s the kind of Hero sought after by Demi-Humans and Beastmen, isn’t that a good match? Just as the legends say.”
“That fact I didn’t want to prove… According to this logic, doesn’t being a stud or something like that also play a role in the qualities needed to be chosen as a Hero?”
“Isn’t that possible? By the way, the legends of the Spear Heroes are concentrated in countries with large human populations. You could say the Spear Hero is a hero of the people.”
Why are we talking about past Spear Heroes?
“I’m the Hero of my Father and Filolial-sama, you know.”
“What on earth are you talking about… Hey, Ren! Why are you trying to change the subject?”
“Don’t drag me into this!”
“It’s true—this isn’t something Ren or Itsuki can just brush off as someone else’s problem! It’s not the kind of thing you can just run away from!”
My father is desperately trying to get Ren to pay attention.
“Naofumi-san! Why are you singling out just me and Ren? What about Motoyasu-san too?”
“That’s right! Why leave Motoyasu out?”
“Well, it’s Motoyasu, right? I mean… Motoyasu is a bit of a mystery in so many ways.”

“Ah… you’re right. It wouldn’t be surprising if there were countless of them, and conversely, it wouldn’t be surprising if there weren’t any. Gaelion, how does that work? Since he’s a ‘human hero,’ does that mean Motoyasu’s kids with his human wife are amazing?”
In response to Itsuki’s question, his rival puffs out his chest, flashes a cheerful smile, and says triumphantly:
“It’d be more fun if I just said ‘no comment’ on that one.”
“What’s so fun about that?!”
“You’ve just been stockpiling nothing but unnecessary knowledge of the future! Don’t mess with us!”
“Well, Yuki, do your best, too.”
When my rival taunted Yuki-chan, who was jogging a short distance away, she replied with a threatening glare.
“Mind your own business!”
“I feel like you should just ask Motoyasu-kun directly here?”
My Father looked at me, so I tried to remember.
“That’s vague! To begin with, I’m devoted solely to Filo-tan and my Father.”
“Just like before—why are you dragging me into this too!?”
“Ah, well, this guy seems like he could go for both, doesn’t he? Naofumi-san seems like the kind of guy both of them would like, too.”
“Wild Naofumi was almost impregnated by Gaelion’s younger brother, you know—”
“Impregnated!?”
My father abruptly pulled away from his Rival.
“To be ‘impregnated’ even though he’s a man… that’s quite profound. If Motoyasu-san’s love becomes transcendent, it seems like a child with Naofumi-san might actually be conceived in this world.”
“Itsuki, I think it’s about time I launched a counterattack. Personally, I’m curious to see how well your ‘Accuracy’ ability adapts to the Magnum under Itsuki’s arm.”
At Father’s retort, Itsuki’s face turned pale in an instant.
“HAHAHA! That’s just like Father! But, Itsuki uses a New Nambu, not a Magnum!”
“Well, coming from me, of all people, this might be a bit much…”
“…New Nambu? Huh!?”

I gracefully dodged Itsuki’s relentless barrage of gunfire—bang, bang, bang. I even leaned back to avoid the very last shot. Attacks from someone like Itsuki are easy to dodge if you know they’re coming.
“Let’s put Motoyasu aside for now… Naofumi! How can you say such a thing!”
Itsuki is ignoring me and shouting at my Father.

“If that ‘100 out of 100’ accuracy were to actually work, not only would a marriage proposal be the most likely outcome, but if I attacked in the chaos, it’d definitely work… After all, the Hero’s child is supposed to be capable.”
“According to the legends of the Bow Hero, there are many stories about them getting along well with both humans and Demi-Humans.”
“Ren! Why are you trying to draw attention to me so you can escape?! You’re single, so you’re the one in the most danger! Gaelion!”
“As for the Sword Hero… well, good luck with that. Black Thunder will get in the way and protect you.”
“Guh…! You’re getting in my way no matter what…”

Ren looks frustrated. That’s rude to Black Thunder. We should call Fleon-chan and Black Thunder over here soon. Come to think of it, Ren from the first world seemed a bit lonely around here, too—though with Éclair and his Assistant nearby, I’m sure he was just fine, wasn’t he?

“As for the legend of the last Sword Hero, there’s one in the Dragon Emperor’s memories who fell in love with a Sword Hero, so if you’re a Sword Hero, looking for a dragon bride might be a good strategy. You could act as a matchmaker for a dragon you become close to when you turn into one. Plus, you might end up with a lively little dragon, just like Fumi’s child.”
“Mind your own business!”

“It might even work as a defense against Black Thunder. Filolial hates dragons, after all, so maybe she’ll tone down those elements of his taste that are a bit too intense for Black Thunder—just a little. I mean, she’s a dragon, right?”
“Naofumi-san! That’s exactly what I’ve been thinking but didn’t say! Ren-san won’t be my friend anymore!”
Itsuki glared at his Father with a look of frustration.
“Hmm… You’re right, that’s a possibility. Dragons are fantastical and look good… but.”
Ren, who had been deep in thought, looked at his Rival.
“The dragons in this world may look cool, but inside, they’re all perverts. A romantic relationship with a guy like that…?”
“…I can’t even argue with that. Gaelion-chan.”
“Say whatever you want~”
That Rival guy isn’t letting it get to him at all, even though he’s being made fun of.
“The heroes’… stud plan, huh… ugh.”
“Lars-chan, please really make sure to get some rest.”
“That’s right, Larsa. You’re carrying the Shield Hero’s child! Some race might come after your life because of that, don’t you think?”
Elephant speaks to Panda with concern.

“Even in Naofumi’s world—where he told me he loved Gaelion—there were scary stories like that. But back then, the baby in Panda’s belly used Magic to fend them off. Magic shot out from her belly, and bamboo sprouted all over the ground in every direction.”
“Oh my—it’s true, when my older sister swims in the ocean, lightning Magic shoots out of her belly to defeat monsters that come near her, doesn’t it?”
Ren and Itsuki, who had been fuming with anger, looked over at Panda and her Big Sister. Then their Father joined them, and they all looked up at the sky.
“Heroes… I wonder what they really are. Do they have a knack for creating monsters?”
“I don’t know… What exactly is ‘compatibility’? Does being too compatible mean you end up becoming the parent of such a terrifying creature?”
“I haven’t the faintest idea… but kids born to compatible couples are scary, aren’t they?”
“For us—who aren’t as obvious heroes as Naofumi and Motoyasu—this is the scariest story of all…”

A few days later, word came that Faubrey and Melromarc had received a massive number of marriage proposals for their heroes. Apparently, most of them specified Itsuki, who seemed to have a high success rate, so they frantically searched for where the information had leaked from and rushed to punish the culprit.

It was a holiday sometime after White Day had passed. The chocolate that Father handed out last month and this month’s white chocolate were delicious. Just as I was thinking, “Come to think of it, chocolate didn’t cause any major incidents in this world,” I saw Itsuki coming.
“Naofumi-san! No, Gaelion-san!”

Itsuki seemed quite agitated as she summoned my Father and my Rival. I headed over as well. There, I found Itsuki standing with Riska… and a creature that looked like a Raph-species. Its height was similar to that of the older Big Sister in her Beastman form after she’d undergone Class Up.
“Who’s this? Does it look like something Motoyasu-kun created using the Raph-species manufacturing process?”
“What’s going on? What’s going on?”
Ren also heard the commotion and came over. Naturally, the villagers had heard the commotion and were gathering as well.
“I have no idea what you’re talking about.”
“You don’t? Well, I was just resting in my room when, accompanied by a strange noise, it came out of the closet…”
“Waaah…”
Apparently, Itsuki had been enjoying a peaceful day off with Riska. Apparently, they were muttering something like, “Looks like today’s going to be a good day~,” or something along those lines.
“Hello!”
“Is it speaking human language? Raph-species don’t talk, do they?”
“Eh, um?”
“Rafu~”

My Big Sister, who was with my Father, and the Raph-species creature are tilting their heads in confusion. Panda is taking it easy in the next town for a routine checkup. By the way, thanks to the devoted care of my Father, Big Sister, and the Raph-species, the baby’s nighttime crying is gradually subsiding. She’s started to smile gently, rather than just wearing a forced grin. Both Ren and Itsuki seem worried about that.
“A monster… maybe?”
“No, this child isn’t a monster. I can tell.”
My assistant said this while pointing at the Raph-species that speaks human language.
“I’m Roughemon! I’m a magical golem created in the future world!”
Silence reigned over the room. After a while, my Father looked up at the sky and said,
“Um… is this kid okay in every sense? You know, in an existential sense?”
“W-well, I guess she’s just barely okay?”
“So, you said a magical golem? Is that different from a monster? I mean, in the sense that it’s not a living creature… though I suppose you could argue that monsters include things like this too…”
“Naofumi, you don’t need to overthink it.”
“Oh, right… So this is a callback to that communication badge I got from Itsuki the other day?”
“He does seem like the type to have handy gadgets, but it has absolutely nothing to do with that.”
I wonder what my Father and the others are talking about? I get that it’s about that badge they won’t give to me, but…
“So, why are you in the past world?”
“I came here to prevent Itsuki—that hopeless Bow Hero who, by marrying Rishia in the future, ended up having a negative impact on his descendants—from getting together with Rishia.”
The creature, who fluently introduced itself as Rafuemon, explained its purpose. I see—so you came to tear Riska and Itsuki apart.
“I figured it was something like that, but ‘good-for-nothing’?”

“Well, the first-generation Itsuki-kun and Rishia-chan were great—he found his sense of justice and did all sorts of good deeds. But their kids all ended up becoming evil leaders or getting into all sorts of trouble! They were punished in the end, but because of debts and reparations, even the descendants of the Itsuki-kun from my era are still paying those reparations as a whole clan.”
Huh? I’ve never heard anything like that. At least, I’ve never heard that Itsuki’s children turned into that sort of scum. I don’t know about his later descendants, though.
“‘Awoke to a sense of justice’…”
“Ah… so it was an inescapable fate, after all.”
Father and Ren speak as if pitying Itsuki, clasping their hands together as if in prayer. Hands pressed together, you see.
“Why are you feeling sorry for him!　That’s not going to happen!”
“But here you are, coming all the way from the future… or rather, it seems you were sent by your descendants to prevent that from happening.”
“That’s exactly why—nice to meet you!”
As Rafuemon finished speaking, my Father looked at Itsuki with sparkling eyes and said,
“You seem to be carrying some kind of tool from the future! Itsuki! So you really were a hopeless boy after all!?”
“Don’t look at me like that and make fun of me! I’m not a good-for-nothing kid! It’s not like I’m hopeless at everything!”
Well, he was chosen as the Bow Hero, after all. It’s true that he isn’t hopeless at everything.
“There’s a character in an anime from my world who’s a lot like Itsuki. He’s got a hidden talent for archery, but other than that, he’s a total loser who gets bullied all the time.”
“Whaaaat! Itsuki-sama isn’t a hopeless kid who gets bullied…”

Riska is correcting him. Since Riska was saved by Itsuki, she’d naturally deny it. Unlike in the first world, this revelation came a bit later. Since I’ve been shot over this before, I’ll just keep quiet and let it slide.
“Come to think of it, Naofumi-san, you’re the kind of otaku who pictures characters like that in your head, aren’t you? So, Rafuemon-san, what did you come here to do to change the future?”

“First, if we trace history back from the notes Rishia-chan wrote, it seems the story is that Itsuki-kun is awakened to justice by a certain Filolial song. Apparently, it was a factor unique to Itsuki-kun. So…”
Is she talking about Fleon-chan? Just as Rafuemon fiddled with the fur on his chest, he pulled out something that looked like a fish cake.
“The Path of Righteousness~Hero’s Song~”
“Cha-cha-cha-chaaan!”
My Father hummed the sound effect with high energy.
“Cha-cha-cha-chaaan!”
I’m imitating him, too!
“Chaaan!”
Ren joined in as well. He even fired off a quick Flash Sword to emphasize the item.
“It’s pan-pa-ka-pan!”
Rival hummed a rather lame sound effect.
“You two!”
Itsuki glared at us with a displeased look. She wasn’t scary at all.
“Try putting this earplug in your ear. With this, you won’t wake up to justice through Filolial’s song anymore.”
